---
title: "Municipalities"
---

{{< include _ledger.md >}}

```{r}
source("_common.R")
municipalities |>
  left_join(council_meta, by = "muni_code") |>
  transmute(Municipality = sprintf("[%s](m/%s.qmd)", muni_name, muni_code),
            Code = muni_code, Wards = n_wards, Seats = total_seats,
            `Majority needed` = majority,
            `Turnout (median, 90% range)` = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", pct(turnout_median),
                                                   pct(turnout_q05), pct(turnout_q95))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
